title: 3 MCP servers for Claude Code (skill test)
voiceLabel: পরীক্ষার ভয়েস: Kokoro am_michael, ১.৩৫ গুণ গতি
goal: আসল অ্যাপ ছাড়ার আগে Claude Code-এ যোগ করার মতো ৩টা MCP সার্ভারের (Supabase, Sentry, Linear) ছোট রিল। এটা স্কিল-পরীক্ষা।

hook.line: Don't ship with Claude Code until you've installed these three MCP servers.

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.body: It lets Claude create tables, run SQL and read logs in your Supabase project, so your backend gets built while you talk.

tools.name: Sentry MCP
tools.body: It lets Claude read your real production errors and stack traces, so it fixes the actual bug, not a guess.

tools.name: Linear MCP
tools.intro: And the third is Linear MCP.
tools.body: It lets Claude create, update and close issues without leaving the terminal, so your board stays honest while you ship.

cta.line: Comment TOOLS, and I'll send you one link with all three.
